rules: Ordinary domain modules and AI context receive typed capability handles, never raw provider secrets.
Credential metadata is secret-free and records provider, scope, audience, expiry, revocation state, and recovery binding.
Browser storage protection is not presented as encryption or device security unless the exact mechanism is qualified.
Passkey/WebAuthn convenience is optional and cannot be the only recovery path for canonical data.

The v0.17.4 static-core release does not admit a passkey/WebAuthn wrapper; the capability remains an explicit deferred/PLATFORM_LIMITED candidate until exact authenticator, origin-migration, re-enrolment, and independent-recovery evidence exists.
Origin, browser profile, device loss, logout, revocation, rotation, export, and restore are explicit lifecycle cases.
A credential/key failure degrades the affected connector or AI route and does not strand local data or Recovery.

Process-restart rehydration is host-mediated: a prior opaque handle may be restored only with a non-secret recovery reference and fresh secret material, remains SESSION_MEMORY, and never serializes raw credentials.
